label: fp8_born_32x1024
rare_format: u16 [n_rare] patterns in rank order; rank = the rare_bits raw bits after ESC
lengths_format: u16 [N*streams_per_row] byte length of each stream (lengths.bin)
offsets_format: u32 [N*streams_per_row + 1] byte offsets of each stream (its first quad) into streams.bin, final = total; stream byte p at offset + (p // 16) * quad_stride + p % 16
table_format: u16 counts[16] for code lengths 1..16, then n_sym symbols u16 in canonical order
